addon.name: IS2OR: AI Integration
addon.description: Replaces the default CS-Cart storefront search with semantic AI-powered search. Falls back to native CS-Cart search automatically when the AI service is unavailable or returns no results.

queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:is2or_risky_products` ( `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `suggestion_id` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `risk` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `action` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `detail_en` text, `detail_ar` text, `prev_status` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `applied_status` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `created_at` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `resolved_at` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:is2or_document_verifications` ( `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `company_id` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `field_id` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `document_type` varchar(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `filename` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `suggestion_id` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `status` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_review', `output` text, `error` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `timestamp` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `company_id` (`company_id`), KEY `suggestion_id` (`suggestion_id`), KEY `status` (`status`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
